# Sub-Issue Templates

## احضر كل الملفات (Get All Files)

This directory contains issue templates for managing sub-issues related to the main project.

### Sub-Issue for Issue #8

The template `sub-issue-fetch-all-files.md` creates a sub-issue for:
- **Arabic Title**: احضر كل الملفات  
- **English Translation**: Get All Files
- **Parent Issue**: #8

### How to Use

1. Go to the [Issues page](https://github.com/ZOOKA-AI/quran.zekr.by.zooka-ai.com/issues/new/choose)
2. Select the "احضر كل الملفات (Get All Files)" template
3. Fill in any additional details
4. Submit the issue

The sub-issue will automatically:
- Link to parent issue #8
- Be labeled as `sub-issue` and `enhancement`
- Include task checklist for tracking progress
- Support both Arabic and English descriptions

### Template Features

- **Bilingual Support**: Templates support both Arabic and English
- **Task Tracking**: Includes checkboxes for tracking progress
- **Auto-linking**: Automatically references parent issue #8
- **Labels**: Pre-configured with relevant labels

## Structure

```
.github/
└── ISSUE_TEMPLATE/
    ├── config.yml                          # Template configuration
    ├── sub-issue-fetch-all-files.md       # Sub-issue template for "احضر كل الملفات"
    └── README.md                           # This file
```
